column2: [intro]
In my room, it's a mess so grand,
Clothes are flying all over, it’s unplanned.
Socks on the chandelier, keys in the fridge,
My daily chaos, it’s my own bridge.
Oh la la, disorder is my domain,
I do everything backward, I’m quite the strange.
Rules aren’t my thing, I’m a free man,
Long live the madness, that’s my big plan!
At the office, it's even worse,
Papers pile up, it’s a big curse.
My colleagues don’t get my genius flair,
I’m the king of chaos, and I’m proud, I swear!
Let me live my life without any bind,
Disorder’s my DNA, leave complaints behind.
I’m the guru of general mess,
And it’s what makes my life the best!
[solo]
Come on, everyone, join the revolution,
Disorder is the only solution.
Let loose, forget all conventions,
And together, let’s live without pretensions!
[outro]
